name: compass-components
description: Product-aware, reusable interface patterns for humans and AI coding agents.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Persistent navigation for application sections when orientation and frequent destination changes justify a dedicated region.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switches between closely related peer panels without changing the surrounding task context.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Shows location in a meaningful hierarchical path and offers navigation to ancestors.

components.name: Command Menu
components.description: Searches available actions for users who benefit from a fast keyboard-oriented command path.

components.name: Button
components.description: Invokes an action in the current context with clear priority and native keyboard behavior.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Reveals a small set of related actions when keeping them continuously visible would add noise.

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Supports comparison and repeated work across records with shared fields.

components.name: Filters
components.description: Narrows a result set with visible, understandable constraints and recovery.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Moves through a bounded result set while preserving location and query context.

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Explains why a region has no content and offers a truthful, useful next step.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Presents persistent, decision-relevant feedback in the context where it matters.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Reserves the shape of known incoming content when that improves continuity without implying false progress.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Keeps a focused decision or task in context when interruption and focus management are justified.

components.name: Field
components.description: Connects a form control with its persistent label, constraints, help and actionable error feedback.

components.name: Conversation
components.description: Presents user messages, agent replies and task context with clear authorship and continuation.

components.name: Agent Status
components.description: Communicates the current observable agent state, including waiting, working, paused or completed.

components.name: Agent Activity
components.description: Summarizes user-relevant actions performed and events during an agent task.

components.name: Progress Steps
components.description: Shows task progress as observable stages and status without exposing private model reasoning.

components.name: Tool Call
components.description: Explains a relevant tool action, its scope and outcome in terms the user can understand.

components.name: Task Progress
components.description: Communicates known progress, uncertainty, cancellation and recovery for a longer-running task.

components.name: File Diff
components.description: Supports review of proposed or completed file changes with clear status and scope.

components.name: Artifact
components.description: Presents a task output with its provenance, available actions and lifecycle.

components.name: Citation
components.description: Connects a generated statement to its source and makes source inspection available.

components.name: Approval
components.description: Requests an informed user decision before a consequential action proceeds.

components.name: Permission Request
components.description: Explains requested capability, scope, duration and effects before access is granted.

components.name: Human in the Loop
components.description: Makes review, correction, handoff and resumption explicit in an agent-assisted workflow.
